description: This file defines a FastAPI router handling deprecated endpoints related to 'submissions', which are backward-compatible wrappers around data asset operations. The endpoints include creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, all of which map to data asset workflows in the backend. The code emphasizes deprecation notices and redirects users towards newer /api/v1/data-assets endpoints.

methods.name: JSONResponse add_deprecation_header(response: JSONResponse)
methods.description: Adds deprecation warning headers to the response indicating clients should switch to the new API endpoints.

methods.name: create_submission( payload: Dict[str, Any], current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a legacy submission, mapped to data asset creation, requiring authentication.

methods.name: get_submission( submission_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a submission, including latest validation status, based on submission ID.

methods.name: trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Triggers validation run for a submission, initiating quality checks.

methods.name: approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of submissions with evidence, including signature verification and SoD validation.
